recommendations.title: Automate the release path end to end
recommendations.rationale: Manual release is the single largest constraint on sponsored delivery.

recommendations.title: Establish an automated regression baseline
recommendations.rationale: Release confidence must be evidence-backed before cadence increases.

recommendations.title: Attach a measurable outcome to every sponsored initiative
recommendations.rationale: Sponsorship without a measure cannot be defended or closed out.

recommendations.title: Introduce explicit WIP limits
recommendations.rationale: Limiting WIP exposes real capacity to the sponsor.

recommendations.title: Draw sponsor reporting from delivery systems
recommendations.rationale: System-sourced reporting removes debate about the numbers.

recommendations.title: Run post-release benefits reviews
recommendations.rationale: Closing the loop makes future sponsorship decisions evidence-led.

definitions.title: Appoint an accountable executive sponsor for every funded initiative
definitions.rationale: Leadership Vacuum shows sponsorship is nominal rather than active, so decisions queue behind an absent decision maker.
definitions.expectedBenefit: Named accountability and a standing decision forum that removes the largest source of delivery latency.

definitions.title: Publish a sponsor decision log with service levels
definitions.rationale: Sponsorship only becomes dependable when decisions are visible, dated and time-bounded.
definitions.expectedBenefit: Decision latency becomes measurable and can be managed down deliberately.

definitions.title: Replace status reporting with outcome-based governance
definitions.rationale: Governance Theatre indicates governance activity is high while decision quality and evidence are low.
definitions.expectedBenefit: Governance time converts into decisions rather than reporting overhead.

definitions.title: Source governance packs directly from delivery tooling
definitions.rationale: Evidence Poor Assessment shows reporting is hand-assembled, so the numbers are debated rather than acted upon.
definitions.expectedBenefit: A single, uncontested view of delivery state for every forum.

definitions.title: Stabilise the delivery system before adding new commitments
definitions.rationale: Firefighting Culture shows unplanned work is displacing committed work, so new commitments will not land.
definitions.expectedBenefit: Predictable throughput and a credible forward commitment line.

definitions.title: Set explicit work-in-progress limits and sequence change centrally
definitions.rationale: Change Absorption Overload shows the organisation is being asked to absorb more change than it can metabolise.
definitions.expectedBenefit: Shorter cycle times and visible real capacity for the sponsor.

definitions.title: Attach a named measure and benefits owner to every initiative
definitions.rationale: Benefits Drift shows value is asserted at approval and never verified after release.
definitions.expectedBenefit: Investment decisions become defensible and closeable on evidence.

definitions.title: Run post-implementation benefits reviews at 90 days
definitions.rationale: Closing the value loop is what converts a delivery record into a sponsorship track record.
definitions.expectedBenefit: Evidence-led prioritisation of the next investment cycle.

definitions.title: Establish an automated regression and deployment baseline
definitions.rationale: Fragile Engineering Base shows release confidence rests on manual effort rather than automated assurance.
definitions.expectedBenefit: Release risk falls and cadence can increase without adding governance.

definitions.title: Protect the current sponsorship operating model
definitions.rationale: Healthy Sponsorship System shows the model is working; the risk is erosion rather than absence.
definitions.expectedBenefit: Sustained delivery advantage through leadership transitions.
